items.evidence: apiLevel 2.13, all volumes (40–200 µL) handled by p300 within its range, no overfilled wells, correct labware; simulator and all checks pass.
Every helper picks up a new tip per well and drops it; tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all pass.
All 13 steps are carried out in order with the right volumes and mix counts, manual steps are recorded with protocol.comment, and the extra blow_outs don't change the outcome.
reagent_in(beads['A1'], 40, mix=40) dispenses 40 µL into each of 96 wells and mixes 10 times, followed by the 5 min incubation comment.
The magnet comment comes before remove_to(90, waste), then two 200 µL ethanol additions each followed by remove_to(200, waste) for every well.
Comments record the 5 min air dry and the magnet disengage; 50 µL water is added with a 10x mix, then the 2 min incubation and magnet re-engage comment follow.
zip(wells, elut) moves 45 µL from each sample well to the matching elution well with a fresh tip; the end_state elution_plate check passes.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all 13 steps in order with correct volumes, pipette choice, and fresh tips per well. All measured checks pass, so every item scores 1.
